title: nixos/paperless: various group membership fixes
watch_selection_basis: PR diff (`gh pr diff 550923`) adds a brand-new `group = lib.mkOption { type = lib.types.str; default = defaultUser; ... };` declaration block directly under `options.services.paperless` (new leaf option, full mkOption declaration line textually present in the diff). It also touches the existing `user` mkOption's description text only (no default/type change) and two config-block lines (SupplementaryGroups / sudo -g invocation) that are not declarations. Per the rule (watch only options whose own mkOption/mkEnableOption/etc. declaration is textually touched), watched: baseline `enable` + the new `group` option. `user`'s description-only edit is noted here but not watched, since no default/type/behavior-relevant part of its declaration changed, only prose.
